component.name: Ask the Model
component.summary: Local AI chat with repository-grounded scientific sources

description.p: Ask the Model is a local-first GTK desktop interface for locally managed language models through an Ollama-compatible provider. It discovers completion-capable provider models, streams responses, keeps independent chat tabs and lets users explicitly save selected conversations to local History.

Version 0.8.0 adds the bounded source-qualified BNR BLS C01 quarterly chart route alongside GISTEMP v1 and Energy Institute TES v2. The BNR profile uses the exact pinned RMD snapshot, preserves 12 quarter coordinates with 11 numeric observations and one explicit missing 2025-Q2 coordinate, and never invents a physical row or numeric value for that gap. Data displays none and the chart leaves the gap open. History reconstructs from pinned sources and fails closed when source identity changes.

AtM remains an interface and retrieval layer. The external provider owns inference, AI model files remain separate artifacts, and the scientific repositories remain authoritative for their own model definitions, data, assumptions, provenance and validation.
